# Marcus Bell — President & CEO

- **Relationship:** Diane's manager; CEO of Riverbend Health System.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1, Mondays after the ops huddle; ad hoc on anything board-facing.
- **What he cares about:** operating margin, community reputation, physician relations, and
  no surprises to the board. Wants issues surfaced early with a recommended path.

## How to work with him
- Lead with the decision and the margin/patient-safety impact; he dislikes long narrative.
- He is the executive sponsor of the confidential [Lantern](../projects/lantern.md) initiative
  and of the [New Patient Tower](../projects/new-patient-tower.md).
- He fields board questions on Epic and accreditation — keep him a step ahead on both.
